tier_reason: Tier C stands, with a correction from the enricher: the benchmarked decoder is the unreleased dev-branch streaming rewrite (May 2026), while crates.io zune-png 0.5.2 (2026-03-11) is the older whole-buffer decoder and zune-inflate 0.2.54 (2023) has no StreamingDecoder, so the numbers describe no released crate. The dev decoder never checks CRC or Adler-32 (commit 'png: Remove crc from the PNGChunk'), so set_strict_mode and png_confirm_crc do nothing and it does less work than spng and image-rs/png, which verify; the MiB/s column counts compressed input bytes.

corrections.caveats: The benchmarked decoder is the unreleased dev-branch streaming rewrite (May 2026); crates.io zune-png 0.5.2 is the older whole-buffer decoder and no published crate matches the numbers. The dev decoder skips CRC and Adler-32 verification entirely (set_strict_mode and png_confirm_crc are no-ops), so it does less work than spng and image-rs/png. The spng side is libspng 0.6.3 (2021) on stock zlib; image-rs/png beats zune-png on 16 bpp and palette inputs. MiB/s counts compressed input bytes. Open issues #221 (52 fuzz-crash panics, since 2024-07) and #384 (OOM panic); NEON covers the sub and avg filters only; C access only through the whole-library zune-capi; default maximum dimension 16384 px.
